title: The Painting Update Mojang Forgot
description: Coming to you from a forgotten USB stick somewhere in Mojang Offices is: THE PAINTING UPDATE MOJANG FORGOT!!! Adds 16 new paintings to Minecraft.
body:
Coming to you from a forgotten USB stick somewhere in Mojang Offices is: **THE PAINTING UPDATE MOJANG FORGOT!!!**

![Some of the paintings in this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/868ca821cdbef5934cfc7321e29e6753c1ef8b3d.png)

Adds **23 new** paintings to Minecraft:
- Action
- Ender Of Man
- Featherfloat
- Foresight
- Giraffe
- Hide and Seek
- Holiday
- Overworldrise
- Redheads
- Squamata
- Leaf
- Honky Nut
- Steve
- Steve 2
- First Encounter
- The Grove
- A Nice Forest
- Vindication
- Steve Face
- Alex Face
- Notdennis
- Soup Cans
- Key Golem

More to come in the **near future**!!!!
Images of all paintings are in the Gallery.

SUPPORTS FABRIC AND NEOFORGE
